Remark
[Why we work on $\mathbb {R}^{n+2}$] This dimension supplies the radial term $(n+1)r^{-1}\partial _r$ and makes all coefficients of (18) smooth at the origin.

\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Asymptotics of the harmonic map flow coefficients]
